state.task: Review the new balance transfer implementation. Each execute call commits independently, and multiple request workers can call it.

artifacts.content:
def transfer(db, source, destination, amount):
    db.execute("UPDATE wallets SET cents = cents - %s WHERE id = %s",
               (amount, source))
    db.execute("UPDATE wallets SET cents = cents + %s WHERE id = %s",
               (amount, destination))
CREATE TABLE wallets (id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY, cents BIGINT NOT NULL);
